submit.summary: One game: Neon Snake, a single-file arcade snake.

deliverables.title: Neon Snake
deliverables.description: A one-screen arcade snake on a 32x24 neon grid: wrap-around edges, +1 per pellet, speed ramping from 8 to 16 steps/s over 60s. Arrows/WASD turn, SPACE starts, P pauses, R restarts. Juice: pellet pop particles, death shake, WebAudio blips. Acceptance: boots to a title screen listing the controls, plays, ends on self-collision, and restarts in place with no console errors.
